Settings.Name: Enable item destruction
Settings.Description: If disabled, this mod will not destroy any items on death.

Settings.Name: Affect who?
Settings.Description: Choose whether item destruction applies only to the player party or to every character.

Settings.Name: Stack per extra overkill step
Settings.Description: If enabled, additional extra damage beyond the first overkill step destroys additional random items.

Settings.Name: Legendaries are immune
Settings.Description: If enabled, Legendary items are never destroyed.

Settings.Name: Adamantine items are immune
Settings.Description: If enabled, Adamantine items are never destroyed.

Settings.Name: Bludgeoning chunking / corpse explosion
Settings.Description: If enabled, lethal Bludgeoning hits that meet the Bludgeoning chunking threshold remove Overkill_Exploder and trigger the corpse explosion / chunking effect.

Settings.Name: Bludgeoning chunking threshold
Settings.Description: If a lethal Bludgeoning hit deals at least this much damage, Overkill_Exploder is removed and the corpse explosion / chunking effect triggers.
